messages:
Ana (Support): Hey team — invoice 2026-045 for Acme EU is on hold. Customer requested reverse‑charge but our VAT check failed. Customer-supplied VAT ID: 'EL123456789'. VIES returned an error 'invalid country prefix'. Putting this on the escalations queue since it's blocking the PO and payment.

validation-bot: Automated VIES check result for EL123456789 -> FAIL
```
POST /vies/validate
{"vat":"EL123456789"}
Response: {"status":"error","message":"invalid country code"}
```

Omar (Billing): Hmm — Greece VATs sometimes come through as GR or EL depending on source. Customer says they're registered in Greece. Can we try normalizing the country prefix? This is preventing net invoice issuance (they need VAT-exempt reverse charge).

Lena (Payments): Good catch. I've seen GR vs EL mismatch in past VIES calls. Quick idea: try both prefixes when a validation fails. Quick repro test: try EL then GR.
```
vat_variants = ["EL123456789", "GR123456789"]
for v in vat_variants:
    call_vies(v)
```

validation-bot: Re-check attempted with alias 'GR': GR123456789 -> PASS.
Details: status=valid, name="ACME TRADING ELLINIKI", request_id=abc-1823

Marco (Accounts): If GR passes, we can accept reverse-charge but we need a manual audit trail: scanned VAT certificate / company registry extract + note in invoice. Process: 1) save VIES pass screenshot 2) request official VAT confirmation (pdf) 3) CC Legal for sign-off. After that Accounting can mark invoice tax_exempt=true and release payment.

Ana (Support): I asked the customer to upload the company VAT confirmation and registry number. Updated ticket #7895 and attached the VIES pass screenshot. Message to customer: "Thanks — we ran an alternate check that shows your VAT ID valid under 'GR'. Please upload an official VAT confirmation PDF so we can clear the invoice."

Omar (Billing): Also filing a small infra/validator task: add country-alias mapping (EL <-> GR) + a retry pass when initial check fails with 'unknown country prefix'. This will reduce manual escalations. Logged infra issue: https://redwood/infra/issue/452

Lena (Payments): Once Marco uploads the docs and Legal signs off, I'll clear the payment hold from our side. Marking as pending_manual_verification rather than held to avoid double-blocking other systems.

Marco (Accounts): Uploaded audit note and attached the scanned VAT confirmation (from customer) to the ticket. Legal looped in (cc). If Legal confirms, I'll update the invoice metadata and post the audit reference ID.

Ana (Support): Thanks — closing the support escalation for now. Please ping me when invoice status changes so I can notify the customer and update PO.

Omar (Billing): Agreed — we'll keep this as follow-up: short term manual override when alias check passes; medium term add prefix normalization in validator.

Lena (Payments): Noted. Keeping payment team on standby to release once docs + sign-off present. :white_check_mark:
